headline: NCLT-convened Equity Shareholders Meeting of BASF India Ltd
sum: BASF India held an NCLT-convened shareholders meeting on 24 June 2026, indicating a court-supervised corporate restructuring or scheme of arrangement under the Companies Act.
detail: BASF India Limited convened an equity shareholders meeting under NCLT supervision on 24 June 2026, with a presentation filed to NSE. NCLT-convened meetings are statutorily rare and typically signal a compromise or arrangement (Scheme) or a demerger requiring member and creditor sanction. The absence of announced transaction details in public domain suggests either a confidential restructuring or an in-flight Scheme not yet disclosed; the presentation PDF itself does not disclose the scheme terms, parties, or consideration in the Bar & Bench abstract. This is a regulatory-stage event requiring follow-up CCI, foreign investment and final NCLT sanction.
